The apartment located on the seventh floor comprises a large open plan living room complete with a bespoke modern kitchen, a large master bedroom boasting a fully tiled en-suite bathroom and fitted wardrobes, two other double bedrooms both benefitting from fitted wardrobes, a second family bathroom and a separate WC. The apartment is finished to an extremely high standard and the development benefits from lift access and a concierge service. Princes House is perfectly located on Kingsway and is only a short walk to Covent Garden and Lincolns Inn Field. It benefits from a number of great transport links including Holborn (Central Line / 0.2 miles) and Covent Garden (Piccadilly Line / 0.3 miles). There are also a number of great bus routes in close proximity. This property would be ideal for students and professionals alike, due to close proximity to the area’s transport links and universities. There is a requirement of a 5 week (rent equivalent under £50,000 per annum) deposit for new and renewed tenancies (or 6 weeks if the annual rent is £50,000 or more).
